tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.content:
WRITING TASK 1

The map shows changes in urban transport usage from 2000 to 2025 in three cities.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.content:
WRITING TASK 2

Some people believe governments should spend more on public services, while others think reducing taxes is more beneficial.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion in relation to two-part question essay.

Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
